prompt: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art sprite concept for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: a single BROOD BUBBLE enemy of the Iron Tide, a medium jelly egg sphere drifting through a teal-violet nebula sea. A large round membrane bubble filled with glossy deep-violet jelly fluid, its outer skin a lighter lilac with a thick darker purple rim, faint vein lines across the membrane and a bright white crescent highlight at the top-left. Curled up asleep inside, clearly visible through the jelly, is a small dark gunmetal mechanical fish embryo with tucked fins, a segmented tail wrapped around its body and a single dim teal eye closed shut. The jelly is filled solid with violet color so no background shows through. Side view facing left, one round chunky silhouette, centered with a generous empty margin on a perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key background. Crisp chunky pixel art with a 1-pixel near-black navy outline at the sprite's native pixel scale, flat saturated fills with three-step shading ramps lit from the top-left, bold simple shape that stays readable at small size, no anti-aliasing, no scenery, no stars, no cast shadow, no glow bleeding onto the background, no text, no labels.
